text: Been trying to get through for nearly an hour so sorry if this is short. My son is 2, he's 38.1 and one of his eyes has gone pink and sticky, keeps gluing shut. He's absolutely fine in himself, wide awake, watching his programmes and chatting away to me. Wet nappies all evening, no problem there. I just want to know if the eye needs seeing tonight or if it can wait till the morning because I'm not sitting in A&E for 5 hours for a sticky eye
